         nges pa rtags kyi mtshan nyid du 'dod pa ni tshul gsum tshad mas nges par byas shing gtan la phab pa kho na <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">he du</foreign> ru 'dod la|_nges rung <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">he du</foreign> ru 'dod pa ni nog dang lkog shal ma nges kyang de dang ldan na ba lang yin pa bzhin du|_du ba yin nam rlangs pa yin the tshom za ba'i tshe yang don du ba de tshul gsum tshad mas nges rung du yod pas <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">he du</foreign> yin no zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsa ba</rs> dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3809">jo btsun</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3834">rgya</rs> bzhed do ||</seg></TEI>
